svg.title: Set s = 1/2000 and split into two cases. Case 1: some Ra or Qb has second eigenvalue at least s. By symmetry take Ra. Let P project onto its two largest eigenvectors, and let z be a unit vector in the complementary line. For each b, choose a unit nb attaining the minimum in (13). Positivity gives ∥Pnb∥2 ≤ε/s and ⟨nb, Qbnb⟩≤ε. After choosing the phase of nb, ∥nb −z∥≤ √︁ 2ε/s. Thus
